claims.text: As you arrive at this renowned seafood restaurant located in the North End Waterfront, established in 1984, you'll be immersed in the legacy of New England's maritime traditions.
The Boston Sail Loft, since 1984, has been a go-to spot for classic New England seafood, offering fantastic Boston Harbor views.
The Boston Sail Loft, perched along Atlantic Avenue since 1984, is a beloved staple of Boston's North End waterfront.
One of the culinary highlights here is the clam chowder, which the Boston Sail Loft has famously infused with fresh dill.
claims.evidence: The Boston Sail Loft introduced clam chowder infused with fresh dill, sparking friendly rivalries and winning Best of Boston awards.

claims.text: Upon entering, the Boston Sail Loft exudes a cozy ambiance reminiscent of a nautical dive-bar-meets-seafood-joint.
claims.evidence: The Boston Sail Loft opened in 1984 as a nautical dive-bar-meets-seafood-joint with a 'first come, first served' policy.

claims.text: Situated in a prime location, the Boston Sail Loft not only serves delectable food but also provides breathtaking views of Boston Harbor, creating an ideal setting to relax and savor a traditional New England meal.
The Boston Sail Loft is open from 11:30 am to 2:00 am on Monday and Tuesday.
They offer their famed clam chowder for $6.50 a cup or $7.25 a bowl, with lobster rolls also available.
